description: The Sylon demo conversation, posted by a test customer in the customer channel. Each step names what the fleet should do with it.

steps.text: Our deploys started failing this morning. Deploy ends with "Deploy failed" and the agent never leaves Linked, and nothing changed on our side.
steps.expect: intake opens a bug issue and posts its card in triage; copilot posts a draft card citing the troubleshooting-build-deploy-run kb page

steps.text: More detail: it is the first deploy of this project, and clicking Deploy again gives the same error.
steps.expect: intake links the reply to the bug issue (no new issue); copilot supersedes its draft with a new one

steps.text: URGENT: production is down for us. Every API call has returned 500 for the last 10 minutes and our checkout is blocked.
steps.expect: intake opens an urgent issue; urgent-pager (once added) DMs on-call

steps.text: Quick question: if our scheduled agent misses a run during downtime, does Sapiom run it later or skip it?
steps.expect: intake opens a question issue; copilot drafts an answer from the schedule kb page (catchupPolicy skip drops missed slots, all replays them)
no new issue: Jev reads it as a thank-you
